Plans (--plan):
  v1check   ablate_pilot v1's configuration (layers 32/36/40, the lens dictionary and v1's Gaussian random dictionary,
            v1's prompts) run with this code; compared item by item with results/ablate_pilot/v1
  depth     contiguous 3-layer bands sliding by 2 over layers 0 to n-2, and every one of those layers at once
  bands     the bands given with --bands, e.g. "32,36,40" "16-28"
Conditions (--conditions): omp25, omp25_rot, omp25_rdict, paper10, paper10_rot, paper10_rdict, keep_own, skip_subject,
  gauss (v1's Gaussian dictionary); 2026-10-21 (C1's second kill test, decided with Zach): paper10_keepown and
  paper10_keepown_rot, paper10 with the bridge's own-word directions (its surface tokens and every dictionary row with
  cosine >= OWN_COS to its concept token, as keep_own) also protected. 2026-10-21 (the specificity control, decided with
  Zach after the pipeline review): unembed10 and unembed10_rot, paper10's procedure over the unit unembedding rows of
  letter tokens (the final norm's gain folded in: the logit lens's directions, the same at every layer) instead of the
  J-lens vectors: is the damage specific to the J-space, or shared by any token-aligned directions? 2026-10-21
  (docs/prereg_sink_1021.md): any top-K condition with "_nosink" before its control suffix (paper10_nosink,
  paper10_nosink_rot, unembed10_nosink, top5_nosink_rot, paper10_keepown_nosink, ...) leaves attention-sink positions
  unedited: position 0 and every position whose residual norm exceeds 10x the prompt's median. Prompt kinds (--kinds): clean (the whole question), hop (the last step alone, as
  v1), step1/step2/step3 (each step alone). Reported per band x family/kind x condition: accuracy (top token = the
  answer's first token) and the mean change in the answer token's log-probability from the unedited run.

amendment72.protF: protected = paper10's (clean top-10 letter rows) + the letter rows of the first token of every form (note 45: stripped decode as written, lower, capitalised; with and without a leading space) of each clean top-10 token
amendment72.protC: protF + every letter row with cosine >= 0.5 to a clean top-10 letter token's atom at that layer
amendment72.keepT10: keep_span = QR of the unit J++ vectors of protF's rows (the top-10's own rows + added forms)
amendment72.keepRT10: random.Random("n49:" + id).sample(letter rows minus protF's rows, |T10 rows|)
amendment72.keepOwn: every form of the item's own answer (note 37's forms: as read and lower case; leading space, either case)
amendment72.keepSib: one sibling answer of the relation (answer_vocab), letter rows disjoint from Own's, row count matched (closest if none), random.Random("n49sib:" + id).choice(sorted candidates)
amendment72.R4perp_R8perp: note 41's rows (random.Random("n41:" + id); R8 = the 8|A| draw, its first 4|A| = R4, asserted), each projected off span(A) per layer and re-orthonormalised (one QR of [Q_A | V]; |R_jj| < 0.001 dropped)
amendment72.onlyA: r' = P_A r under paper10's protection (+ _rot: turned by the same rotation)
amendment72.ansRk: answer_span_edit over random.Random("n50:" + id).sample(letter rows minus A's rows, |cands2 rows|)
amendment72.topK_keepA: topK's removal (paper10's protection: the clean top-10 letter rows) minus its part in span(A)
amendment72.CapPerp_CtyPerp: note 44's Cap span projected off the item's Cty span per layer (and the reverse), as R4perp
amendment72.Shared: bisectors of the principal vectors of span(Cap) and span(Cty) with cosine >= 0.9
amendment72.keeplog: keeplog.jsonl: per item, in paper10's (and topK's) forward, summed over the band's layers and edited positions: E_X = sum |P_X r|^2 / sum |r|^2 for each keep; alpha_X = 1 - sum |P_A (r - P_X r)|^2 / sum |P_A r|^2; for protF / protC (their removal r_X recomputed on paper10's residuals) E_X = 1 - sum <r, r_X> / sum |r|^2 and the share of paper10's answer part they still remove, sum |P_A r_X|^2 / sum |P_A r|^2; ranks; |edit| / |h|. The new conditions' rows carry keeplog: |edit| / |h| in their own forward and the kept rank / protected row count

amendment78.onlyRperp: r' = P_X r; X = the first k columns of QR([Q_A | V]) beyond A (V: random.Random("n41:" + id).sample(note 41's pool, 16 |A|), its first 4 |A| = note 41's R4, asserted); k per item = the smallest whose share of paper10's removal energy (paper10's forward, summed over layers and positions) reaches E_A (all 16 |A| if none: reached false)
amendment78.topK_keepRE: topK's removal minus its part in span(first k of the same 16 |A| rows), k per item energy-matched to E_A in topK's forward (nested QR of the rows)
amendment78.ansRe: answer_span_edit over the first k of random.Random("n50:" + id).sample(letter rows minus A's, 16 |cands2 rows|) (its first |cands2 rows| = ansRk's), k = the smallest whose removed energy reaches ansJ's in ansJ's forward
amendment78.keepRivals: keep span = every form (note 37's) of every relation answer (not gold) with a form among the clean top-10 tokens, gold's form rows removed
amendment78.keepRandRivals: as many random relation answers (not gold, not rivals, no form in the top-10, no gold row), each matched to a rival's form-row count (closest), random.Random("n57rr:" + id) order
amendment78.logs: n57_rows.jsonl (rows, rivals, tokens), n57_log.jsonl (per item and matching forward: k, reached, E_target, E_match); rows: edit_rel, keeplog.rank
